lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's sixteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 16? Nope!

lines.text: Each square is red, blue or green. The center is red. Touching squares must differ.
lines.caption: Each square is red, blue or green. The center is red. Touching squares must differ.

lines.text: The four edge squares touch red, so each is blue or green. That's sixteen patterns.
lines.caption: The 4 edge squares touch red, so each is blue or green. That's 16 patterns.

lines.text: A corner gets two options if its neighbors match. If not, only red works.
lines.caption: A corner gets 2 options if its neighbors match. If not, only red works.

lines.text: All four edges match: two times sixteen is thirty-two. Taking turns: just two.
lines.caption: All 4 edges match: 2 times 16 is 32. Taking turns: just 2.

lines.text: The other twelve give four each. That's forty-eight.
lines.caption: The other 12 give 4 each. That's 48.

lines.text: Thirty-two plus forty-eight plus two. That's eighty-two!
lines.caption: 32 plus 48 plus 2. That's 82!

lines.text: Sixteen was the trap. It forgets the corners!
lines.caption: 16 was the trap. It forgets the corners!

lines.text: Did you get eighty-two? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 82? Tell me below!
